# v1.0.0 — Bilingual Edition

First complete public edition of the Bash Professional Reference.

Highlights:
- 14 mirrored Persian/English chapters
- scripting, automation, system administration, DevOps, defensive security, debugging, portability
- source consolidation from the supplied Word documents with repeated filler removed
- GNU Bash 5.3 semantics cross-check
- strict CI and documentation QA
- versioned `latest` and `v1.0` publishing structure
